C1322.title: Petya/NotPetya Leveraged LotL Tools for Mass Propagation
C1322.summary: The 2017 global Petya/NotPetya outbreak heavily exploited Living off the Land techniques. Attackers used Mimikatz to dump credentials from memory, then leveraged stolen account credentials to remotely execute themselves via PsExec and WMI command-line tools for lateral movement. Built-in system utilities and legitimate admin software were abused as propagation vectors, but the malware still dropped malicious components such as a DLL file for initial infection and payload execution.
